categories.main_business_segments: BYD Electronic operates primarily in manufacturing, assembling, and selling mobile handset components, modules, and other high-tech products. Its diversified business includes consumer electronics (smartphones, tablets, game hardware), new energy vehicles (intelligent cockpit systems, driving systems, thermal management), AI data centers, smart homes, unmanned aerial vehicles, 3D printers, Internet of Things, robots, and communication equipment.
categories.core_technologies_production_methods: The company leverages core technologies such as electronic information, artificial intelligence (AI), 5G, Internet of Things (IoT), thermal management, new materials, precision molds, and digital manufacturing technologies. It emphasizes vertical integration, precision manufacturing, automation, and digitalized production processes, with strong R&D capabilities in innovative materials, product design, and automation.
categories.primary_customers_markets: BYD Electronic serves major global customers in consumer electronics, particularly in the high-end Android smartphone market, and has strategic cooperation with large overseas customers. It also serves the new energy vehicle industry with intelligent cockpit and driving systems, and AI data center clients requiring AI servers and liquid cooling solutions. Its products cater to smartphone manufacturers, automotive companies, cloud service providers, and industrial robotics users.
categories.geographic_coverage: The Group operates globally with significant revenue from both the People's Republic of China (including Hong Kong, Macau, and Taiwan) and overseas markets. In 2024, approximately 31% of revenue was from the PRC region and 69% from overseas customers. It has registered offices in Hong Kong and principal operations in Shenzhen, China.
categories.supply_chain_position: BYD Electronic operates primarily in the midstream and downstream segments of the supply chain, focusing on manufacturing and assembly of components and modules for smartphones, new energy vehicles, and AI data center equipment. It also integrates product design and R&D, providing one-stop product solutions to its customers.
categories.strategic_focus_rd_direction: The Group prioritizes strengthening core technology R&D and high-end manufacturing innovation, focusing on AI, 5G, IoT, and green technologies like liquid cooling for data centers. It is expanding in new intelligent product areas such as AI data centers, AI robots, and autonomous mobile logistics robots. The company aims to deepen strategic cooperation with key customers, expand product portfolios, and accelerate growth in new energy vehicle solutions and intelligent electronics.
categories.revenue_model: BYD Electronic generates revenue mainly through product sales of components, modules, and assembled products for consumer electronics, new energy vehicles, and AI data centers. The revenue includes sales of parts and assembly services, with significant contributions from high-end Android smartphone components and new energy vehicle systems.
categories.key_competitors_industry_positioning: While specific competitors are not named, BYD Electronic is positioned as a global leading provider in high-tech innovative products with a strong foothold in the Android high-end smartphone market and new energy vehicle components. It holds a leading market position in intelligent cockpit systems, AI servers, and liquid cooling technologies, leveraging first-mover advantages and vertical integration.
categories.financial_scale_growth_profile: In 2024, BYD Electronic recorded revenue of approximately RMB177.3 billion, a 36.43% increase year-on-year, with profit attributable to owners of RMB4.27 billion, up 5.55%. The company has shown consistent growth driven by consumer electronics and new energy vehicle segments. It maintains a gearing ratio of 18.01% and employs about 150,000 staff globally.
categories.value_proposition_product_differentiatio: The company offers one-stop high-tech product solutions leveraging advanced technologies in AI, 5G, IoT, thermal management, and precision manufacturing. Its vertical integration, strong R&D capabilities, and strategic partnerships enable it to deliver high-quality, innovative, and customized products that enhance customer competitiveness, particularly in high-end Android smartphones and intelligent new energy vehicle systems.
